scope: One unexecuted LLVM compile and 115 complete expression-contract/1 K traces proposed after source repair. No financial transition, proof, network, installation, or public action.

limits.outputLimitMeaning: The post-exit sum of captured stdout and stderr must be at most 64 MiB; this is not a streaming quota.
limits.parserBudgetMeaning: At most one parser invocation per counted krun. Its runtime is within that krun's 20-second and aggregate limits.

requestedDeltaFromProposal02.reason: Two adjacent 65536/65537 invalid-schema-domain controls are required to verify repaired precedence.

containment: A systemd user-service control group contains all descendants. The runner uses a new process group and kills it on its timeout. The named unit and nonblocking flock serialize the experiment. Runtime expiry sends SIGKILL to the complete control group without a TERM extension.
stopRule: Stop on the first failed compile, trace, decoder, expected-result, source-integrity, timeout, or resource control. No retry, fallback, counter reset, compile, krun, kast, kprove, native proof, service, network, or public dispatch is authorized by this proposal.
prerequisites: Fresh Astra medium and Grok 4.6 high source/resource reviews of exact candidate and proposal
Root preflight validates source/toolchain hashes, capacity, idle heavy-run state, and absent expression compile attempt
Explicit root admission after both reviews
